[{"id":"0SultSYg_F","type":"header","data":{"text":"Lab Manufacturing Process","col":12}},{"id":"WDX9cuDqq6","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Manufacturing Request","col":3}},{"id":"tShoRFFaW9","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"  1. Starting point of the manufacturing cycle. Click Add Material Request and fill in Purpose (Manufacture), Company, Project, and Required By Date.
2. In the Items table, Enter the raw materials required for production.
3. Open the Finished Product Specification tab, select the Routing — System will auto populate child table  — and select the Item (Finished Product). Save and Submit.
4. From the Create menu, click Work Order to proceed to the next step.)  ","col":12}},{"id":"5lDyTaDrD3","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Bill of Materials (BOM)","col":3}},{"id":"9Q8qbdks97","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"1. In this system, BOM is not created manually. It is automatically generated upon submission of the Material Request based on predefined logic and mappings.
2. When the Material Request is submitted:
    . System identifies the Finished Good Item
    . Fetches the relevant Raw Materials
    . Determines the required quantities based on defined rules / planning
3. The system automatically pulls the following into the BOM:
    . Raw Materials (as selected / mapped in Material Request)
    . Finished Good (target production item)
    . Operations (linked through predefined Routing or configuration)
    . Workstations and Operation Time
4.Costing is also auto-populated:
    .  Operation-wise cost is fetched from Workstation / Routing setup
    .  Material cost is derived from item valuation rate
    . Total BOM cost is calculated automatically ","col":12}},{"id":"qmKe_Vkx72","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Work Order","col":3}},{"id":"9j9SyFvYEf","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"  Created in Draft from the Material Request via Create → Work Order. The system generates Work Order for all finished goods for all Each Operation.
All related Work Orders appear under the Connections Section of Manufacturing Request as well.
1. Open each Work Order and configure: Source Warehouse, Target Warehouse, Workstation (where the operation will be performed), and Planned Start Date. Save, Submit.(On submission, a Job Card is automatically created in Draft as the next action).
2. and click Start. it will route to Stock Entry for material Transfer for manufacturing Setting Save, Submit. The Work Order status moves to In Progress.  ","col":12}},{"id":"9-77IRfX0E","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Material Transfer for Manufacture","col":3}},{"id":"RpxACRaPFQ","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"1. This step is used to physically move raw materials from the Source Warehouse (e.g., Stores) to the Work In Progress (WIP) or Production Warehouse before starting 2. production.
2. From the Work Order, click Start → Stock Entry (Material Transfer for Manufacture). The system will auto-fetch required raw materials based on BOM.
3. In the Stock Entry:
  . Set Source Warehouse (Raw Material Store)
  . Set Target Warehouse (WIP / Production Area)
  . Verify quantities as per BOM (can adjust if required)
4. Save and Submit the entry.","col":12}},{"id":"G7R10FmDCs","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Job Card","col":3}},{"id":"vd0c26oxMZ","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"1. Job Card is used to execute and track each operation defined in the Routing (e.g., Wash, Press, etc.).
2. Job Cards are automatically created when the Work Order is submitted.
3. In each Job Card:
     . Define Workstation (where operation is performed)
     . Enter Qty to Manufacture
     . System shows Total Work Order Qty
     . Record Start Time and End Time
4. Add operation-level details in a custom Micron Table, including:
     . Micron Size
     . Grams Collected
     . METRC Tag
     . Quality Tag
     . Collected By
5. Submit Job Card after completing operation. ","col":12}},{"id":"EvxqOiM1fK","type":"shortcut","data":{"shortcut_name":"Manufacture","col":3}},{"id":"Lv-Rlaih_g","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"1. This step is used to produce the Finished Goods and consume raw materials.
2. From the Work Order, click Finish → Stock Entry (Manufacture).
3. In the Stock Entry:
    .Raw materials are consumed from WIP Warehouse.
    . Finished Goods are received in Target Warehouse.
4. Enter actual produced Quantity (can differ from BOM for yield tracking).
5. Save and Submit the Entry.","col":12}}]
